use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE

enum Cell is
    EMPTY, TREE, BURNING
si

use Forest = List[List[Cell]]

let columns = 80
let rows = 60
let cell = 3
let generations = 120

let grow = 0.03D
let lightning = 0.0002D

let random = System.Random(2024)

inside(row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    row > 0 /\ row < rows - 1 /\ column > 0 /\ column < columns - 1

near_fire(forest: Forest, row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    (row - 1::row + 1)
        |> flat_map(r => (column - 1::column + 1) |> map(c => (r, c)))
        |> any(((r, c)) => forest[r][c] == Cell.BURNING)

next(forest: Forest, row: int, column: int) -> Cell =>
    if !inside(row, column) then
        Cell.EMPTY
    else
        case forest[row][column]
        when Cell.BURNING then Cell.EMPTY
        when Cell.TREE then
            if near_fire(forest, row, column) \/
                random.next_double() < lightning
            then
                Cell.BURNING
            else
                Cell.TREE
            fi
        else
            if random.next_double() < grow then Cell.TREE else Cell.EMPTY fi
        esac
    fi

step(forest: Forest) -> Forest =>
    (0..rows)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..columns)
                |> map(column => next(forest, row, column))
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

census(forest: Forest, state: Cell) -> int =>
    forest |> flat_map(row => row) |> filter(c => c == state) |> count()

draw(image: IMAGE, forest: Forest) is
    image.clear(60ub, 45ub, 30ub)

    for (row, cells) in forest |> index() do
        for (column, state) in cells |> index() do
            case state
            when Cell.TREE then image.colour(40ub, 140ub, 60ub)
            when Cell.BURNING then image.colour(255ub, 140ub, 30ub)
            else continue
            esac

            let x = cast double(column * cell)
            let y = cast double(row * cell)

            image.fill_rectangle(
                x, y, x + cast double(cell), y + cast double(cell))
        od
    od
si

let forest mut =
    (0..rows)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..columns)
                |> map(column =>
                    if inside(row, column) /\ random.next_double() < 0.5D
                    then Cell.TREE
                    else Cell.EMPTY
                    fi)
                |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

let image = IMAGE(columns * cell, rows * cell)
let animation = ANIMATION(columns * cell, rows * cell)

write_line("generation  trees  burning")

for generation in 0..generations do
    if generation % 10 == 0 then
        let trees = census(forest, Cell.TREE)
        let burning = census(forest, Cell.BURNING)

        write_line("{generation,10} {trees,6} {burning,8}")
    fi

    draw(image, forest)
    animation.add(image, 80)

    forest = step(forest)
od

animation.write("forest.png")

animation.show("forest.png")
